blocks.text: Yeh chapter 31 (Materials and Energy) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define a material. On what are materials understood and selected? Name five classes of materials discussed in the chapter with one use of each. (4 marks)
(Material ki definition likhein. Materials ko kis bunyaad par samjha aur chuna jata hai? Chapter ki paanch qisam ke materials aik aik istemal ke saath batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Material: koi bhi substance ya substances ka mixture jo rozmarra ya sanati ahmiyat ki physical cheez banaye, jaise plastics, metals, ceramics, building material.

Samajh: materials ki thermal, mechanical (hardness, elasticity) aur chemical properties behtar hoti hain; inhen composition, chemical bonds ki nature aur microstructure se samjha jata hai.

Intikhab (selection): material ko us ki physical, chemical, mechanical, electrical aur thermal khususiyaat dekh kar chuna jata hai.

Qisamen aur istemal:
• Metals aur alloys – pulon mein steel, wires mein copper
• Ceramics – refractory bricks, porcelain insulators, spark plugs (alumina)
• Polymers – bare organic ya inorganic molecules, jaise poly(ethene) bags
• Composites – fibreglass ki boat hulls aur car bodies
• Semiconductors – microchips aur solar panels mein silicon

book_ref.quote: Materials have superior thermal, mechanical (e.g., hardness, elasticity, etc.) and chemical properties.

blocks.prompt:
2 Describe the properties of metals and how they occur in nature. Explain ores and gangue with an example. (4 marks)
(Metals ki properties aur fitrat mein un ki mojoodgi bayan karein. Ores aur gangue misaal ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Properties: metals sakht, mazboot aur heat aur bijli ke achhe conductors hain. Yeh malleable aur ductile hain, is liye toote baghair chadar ya taar ban jate hain. Steel pulon mein (mazbooti), aluminium aircraft body mein (halka) aur copper wires mein (conductivity).

Mojoodgi: metals zyada tar zameen ki tah (earth crust) mein milti hain.
• Free state: kam reactive metals jaise gold aur platinum metallic shakal mein milti hain.
• Combined state: zyada reactive metals jaise sodium, aluminium, iron, copper ores ki shakal mein, jaise haematite (Fe₂O₃) iron ki ore hai.

Ores aur gangue: ores khalis compounds nahi balke matloob metal compound, impurities aur mitti wale materials ka mixture hain; mitti wale hisse ko gangue kehte hain. Metals ores se physical aur chemical processes (metallurgy) ke zariye nikali jati hain.

book_ref.quote: Metals are mostly found in the earth crust.

blocks.prompt:
3 Explain the conversion of a concentrated ore into the metal oxide. Describe roasting and calcination with equations and compare them. (4 marks)
(Concentrated ore ko metal oxide mein badalna samjhayein. Roasting aur calcination equations ke saath bayan karein aur muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Mining aur ore concentration ke baad concentrated ore ko metal oxide mein badla jata hai, zyada tar do tareeqon se.

Roasting: metal ki sulphide ore ko zyada hawa mein garam kiya jata hai.
2ZnS(s) + 3O₂(g) → 2ZnO(s) + 2SO₂(g)

Calcination: metal carbonate ore ko kam ya baghair hawa ke garam karke oxide banaya jata hai.
ZnCO₃(s) → ZnO(s) + CO₂(g)

Phir oxide ko reduce karke metal hasil ki jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Metallurgy involves a series of processes to finally obtain the purest form of a metal.

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe the reduction of metal oxides to metals. Explain the carbon (CO) method and the electrolytic method, giving the metals for which each is used. (4 marks)
(Metal oxides ki metal mein reduction bayan karein. Carbon (CO) tareeqa aur electrolytic tareeqa samjhayein aur batayein kaun sa kin metals ke liye hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Metal oxides ki reduction metal nikalne ka sab se ahem step hai; tareeqa metal ki reactivity par munhasir hai.

(i) Carbon se reduction: kam reactive metals (reactivity series mein carbon se neeche) ke liye. Carbon pehle CO banta hai jo metal oxide se oxygen nikal kar free metal banata hai. Iron ore:
C + ½O₂ → CO
Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂

(ii) Electrolytic tareeqa: carbon se zyada reactive metals ke oxides carbon reduce nahi kar sakta. In ke compounds pighla kar current guzara jata hai, jis mein kafi energy lagti hai. Positive metal ions negative electrode (cathode) par ja kar electrons lete hain aur metal bante hain.
Bohat reactive metals jaise Na, K, Al ke liye, aur kam reactive metals jaise Cu ki bohat zyada purity ke liye.

book_ref.quote: Different techniques are used for different metals depending on their reactivity.

blocks.prompt:
5 388 g of zinc sulphide is roasted: 2ZnS(s) + 3O₂(g) → 2ZnO(s) + 2SO₂(g). Calculate (i) the mass of oxygen used, (ii) the mass of ZnO formed and (iii) the mass of SO₂ released. (Molar masses: ZnS = 97, O₂ = 32, ZnO = 81, SO₂ = 64 g mol⁻¹.) Show that mass is conserved. (4 marks)
(388 g zinc sulphide roast ki jati hai: 2ZnS(s) + 3O₂(g) → 2ZnO(s) + 2SO₂(g). Maloom karein (i) istemal hone wali oxygen ka mass, (ii) banne wali ZnO ka mass, (iii) nikalne wali SO₂ ka mass. (Molar masses: ZnS = 97, O₂ = 32, ZnO = 81, SO₂ = 64 g mol⁻¹.) Mass ka tahaffuz dikhayein.)
blocks.explanation: ZnS ke grams ko moles mein badlein, 2 : 3 : 2 : 2 ka mole ratio lagayein, phir moles ko wapas grams mein badlein.

book_ref.quote: This can be done in two ways, mostly.

blocks.final_answer: O₂ = 192 g; ZnO = 324 g; SO₂ = 256 g; dono taraf kul mass 580 g.

blocks.prompt:
6 480 kg of haematite (Fe₂O₃) is reduced: C + ½O₂ → CO and Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂. Calculate (i) the moles of CO needed, (ii) the mass of carbon needed to make this CO and (iii) the mass of iron produced. (Molar masses: Fe₂O₃ = 160, C = 12, Fe = 56 g mol⁻¹.) (4 marks)
(480 kg haematite (Fe₂O₃) reduce ki jati hai: C + ½O₂ → CO aur Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂. Maloom karein (i) CO ke kitne moles chahiye, (ii) yeh CO banane ke liye kitna carbon chahiye, (iii) kitna iron banega. (Molar masses: Fe₂O₃ = 160, C = 12, Fe = 56 g mol⁻¹.))
blocks.explanation: Fe₂O₃ ke kmol nikalein; har aik ko 3 CO (har CO ke liye aik C) chahiye aur 2 Fe banta hai.

book_ref.quote: An example is the reduction of the iron ore as follows:

steps: Fe₂O₃ ke moles = 480 000 g / 160 = 3000 mol = 3.0 kmol
blocks.final_answer: CO = 9.0 kmol; carbon = 108 kg; iron = 336 kg.

blocks.prompt:
7 What is alloying and why is it done? Give the constituents, properties and uses of four common alloys. (4 marks)
(Alloying kya hai aur kyun ki jati hai? Chaar aam alloys ke ajza, properties aur istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Alloying do ya zyada metals ko mila kar homogeneous solution banana, ya metal ko non-metal se milana hai. Is se metal ka microstructure badal kar strength, corrosion resistance aur electrical ya magnetic properties behtar ki jati hain. Yeh metallurgy ka refining ke baad aakhri step hai.

book_ref.quote: Alloying involves the mixing of any two or more metals to give a homogeneous solution

rows: Iron (98-99%) + carbon (0.1-2%) (aur Cr, Ni, Mn, Si, S)

blocks.prompt:
8 What are ceramics? Give their chemical nature and explain their important properties with an application of each. (4 marks)
(Ceramics kya hain? In ki chemical nature batayein aur ahem properties aik aik application ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ceramics sakht magar brittle materials hain jin ka melting point zyada aur insulation behtareen hai, is liye yeh zyada temperature aur electrical kaamon ke liye munasib hain.

Chemical nature: alkali, alkaline earth metals aur aluminium ke silicates aur oxides ka mel, jaise K₂O, Na₂O, CaO, Al₂SiO₅. Mazboot bonds aur pakki structures inhen strength, paedaari aur corrosion aur heat se hifazat dete hain.

Istemal: pottery, furnaces, tiles aur sanitary ware (porcelain), windows aur optical fibres (glass), spark plugs (alumina).

book_ref.quote: which make them fit in high temperature and electrical applications

rows: Zyada melting point – bohat zyada temperature par bhi solid
Steel furnaces ki lining ki refractory bricks
Hardness aur wear resistance – kharoch lagna bohat mushkil
Abrasives (sandpaper mein silicon carbide), cutting tools
Electrical insulator – aksar bijli nahi guzarte
Chemical inertness – corrosion aur chemical hamle se mehfooz
Chemical processing equipment par ceramic coatings

blocks.prompt:
9 What is a composite? Describe fibreglass and carbon fibre as composites, giving their properties and uses. (4 marks)
(Composite kya hai? Fibreglass aur carbon fibre ko composites ke taur par un ki properties aur istemal ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Composite do ya zyada materials ka mel hai jis se behtar properties wali cheez banti hai. Is mein aik matrix aur us ke andar band aik ya zyada reinforcement agents hote hain.

Fibreglass: matrix polymer hai; reinforcement fabric, glass ya carbon wale fibres ho sakte hain. Istemal: boat hulls aur car bodies; deewaron aur chhat ko garmi sardi se insulate karna (Figure 31.3).

Carbon fibre: halka aur bohat paedaar hone ki wajah se aircraft aur sports gear industry mein.

Composites ki properties: achha strength-to-weight ratio aur corrosion se mazboot hifazat, is liye mushkil kaamon ke liye munasib.

book_ref.quote: Composites are very efficient and useful modern day materials.

blocks.prompt:
10 What are semiconductors? How do they differ from conductors? Describe silicon, gallium arsenide and gallium nitride with their applications. (4 marks)
(Semiconductors kya hain? Yeh conductors se kaise mukhtalif hain? Silicon, gallium arsenide aur gallium nitride un ke istemal ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Semiconductors woh substances hain jo sirf khaas halaat mein bijli guzarte hain aur roshni, heat aur voltage se mutasir hote hain; is liye jadeed electronics mein ahem hain.

Conductors se farq: semiconductor mein current ko zaroorat ke mutabiq control kiya ja sakta hai.

• Silicon (Si): sab se aam semiconductor, effective aur waafir; microchips aur solar panels mein. Mobile SIM card silicon chip aur copper connectors jaise chhote parts se bana hai; silicon device mein data guzar, store aur process kar sakta hai.
• Gallium arsenide (GaAs): wireless communication, jaise 5G internet devices.
• Gallium nitride (GaN): electric cars mein fast charging, behtar conductivity ki wajah se.

book_ref.quote: Due to these characteristics, they are important in modern electronic applications.

blocks.prompt:
11 Define toxicity. Explain the health, physical and environmental hazards of materials with examples. (4 marks)
(Toxicity ki definition likhein. Materials ke health, physical aur environmental hazards misaalon ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Toxicity woh had hai jis tak substance jaandaar ya mahol ko nuqsan de sakta hai. Material tayyari, istemal aur aakhri disposal mein zehreela ho sakta hai; toxicity hazard ki had aur qisam se naapi jati hai.

(i) Health hazards: samna hone par sehat ko nuqsan. Chromium jaisi metals carcinogen (cancer), mutagen (DNA aur genes badalna) hain aur saans ke masail deti hain; plastics ke kuch additives hormonal masail dete hain.

(ii) Physical hazards: physical ya chemical properties ki wajah se buildings, insaan, ecosystem aur mahol ko nuqsan, jaise flammable ya explosive material insaan, jangal ya building ko nuqsan de.

(iii) Environmental hazards: aabi zindagi ya mahol ko lamba nuqsan. Lead, mercury aur cadmium mitti aur zameeni paani mein riss kar paudon, janwaron, machhliyon aur aabi jaandaaron ke liye khatarnak hain.

book_ref.quote: Hazards posed by a material are of many types.

blocks.prompt:
12 Discuss heavy metals and plastics as major toxic materials. (4 marks)
(Heavy metals aur plastics ko bare zehreele materials ke taur par bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Plastics aur heavy metals do bari pareshaniyan hain. Behtar properties ki wajah se aam istemal hote hain magar in ke lambe arse ke asraat jaan-leva hain.

Heavy metals: lead (Pb), mercury (Hg) aur cadmium (Cd) electronics, batteries aur fluorescent lights mein aam hain. Yeh zameeni paani mein ja kar wahan se jaandaaron tak pohanchti hain.

Plastics: bohat se plastics mein phthalates ya bisphenol A (BPA) jaise zehreele additives hote hain jo hormones mein khalal daalte hain. Microplastics ab samandar, mitti aur khane mein bhi milte hain aur insaan aur ecosystem par lamba asar daalte hain.

book_ref.quote: These materials are commonly used due to their superior properties.

blocks.prompt:
13 Explain the importance of recycling and describe the three main challenges associated with it. (4 marks)
(Recycling ki ahmiyat samjhayein aur is se jure teen bare challenges bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ahmiyat: recycling waste management, wasail ki hifazat aur energy ki bachat ka ahem hissa hai. Yeh landfills mein kachra kam karti hai, metals, tel aur lakri jaise mehdood wasail bachati hai aur energy bachati hai – aluminium ki recycling raw ore ke muqable mein 95 percent kam energy leti hai.

Challenges:
(i) Material separation: aaj ki cheezen (mobile phones, laptops) mile jule materials se bani hain jo asaani se alag nahi hote, jaise metals par plastic coating ya multi-layered packaging films.
(ii) Mehngi reprocessing: chhantai, safai waghera mehngi hai aur plastics aur electronics ki reprocessing bohat energy leti hai; jab yeh materials kahin aur saste milen to yeh ghair-maashi hai.
(iii) Contamination: recycled metals aur plastics dyes, chemicals ya biological materials se aaluda ho kar quality aur hifazat kho dete hain; contaminated plastic food-grade istemal ke liye recycle nahi ho sakta.

book_ref.quote: Recycling is an important aspect of waste management, conservation of resources and energy saving.

blocks.prompt:
14 Describe the methods and chemical principles of recycling plastics, metals, paper and glass. (4 marks)
(Plastics, metals, paper aur glass ki recycling ke tareeqe aur chemical usool bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Table 31.3 ahem materials ki recycling ka khulasa hai.

book_ref.quote: Table 31.3 Principles and methods of recycling of some important materials

rows: Chhantai, safai, pighlana aur dobara shakal dena; contamination aur polymer chains ke kharab hone se mehdood
Heat, solvents ya catalysts se polymer chains ko asal monomers ya saada chemicals mein torna; khalis reactants milte hain
Metals (steel, aluminium) – thermal aur chemical refining
Pighla kar impurities nikalna; kafi energy magar primary production se bohat kam
Fibres ki chemical aur mechanical alehdgi; NaOH ya Na₂CO₃ se ink aur dyes nikalna
Toota glass (cullet) saaf, chura aur pighla kar naya glass; aasan kyun ke glass non-crystalline solid hai

blocks.prompt:
15 A plant recycles 2.5 tonnes (2500 kg) of aluminium. If producing 1 kg of aluminium from its raw ore needs 200 MJ (assumed value), calculate (i) the energy needed to produce this aluminium from ore, (ii) the energy needed to recycle it, and (iii) the energy saved. Use the chapter's figure for the saving. (4 marks)
(Aik plant 2.5 tonnes (2500 kg) aluminium recycle karta hai. Agar ore se 1 kg aluminium banane mein 200 MJ lagte hain (farz karein), to maloom karein (i) ore se itna aluminium banane ki energy, (ii) recycle karne ki energy, (iii) bachne wali energy. Bachat ke liye chapter ka adad istemal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Aluminium ki recycling 95% kam energy leti hai, yani primary energy ka sirf 5%.

book_ref.quote: the recycling of aluminium consumes 95 percent less energy

blocks.final_answer: Ore se: 5.0 × 10⁵ MJ; recycling: 2.5 × 10⁴ MJ; bachat: 4.75 × 10⁵ MJ.

blocks.prompt:
16 Write a note on X-ray crystallography: what it is, why X-rays are used, and its applications in science and industry. (4 marks)
(X-ray crystallography par note likhein: yeh kya hai, X-rays kyun istemal hoti hain, aur science aur industry mein is ke istemal.)
blocks.explanation:
X-ray crystallography aik mazboot analytical tool hai jo crystalline solid mein atoms ki teen-dimensional jagahen maloom karta hai. Yeh material science, biochemistry aur pharmaceutical chemistry mein ahem hai kyun ke is se structures nazar aati hain.

X-rays kyun: X-rays ki wavelength bohat chhoti hai, is liye yeh molecule ya ionic compound mein electrons aur atoms ki jagah bata sakti hain. Solids atoms ki layers ya strands se bane hain; crystal par girne wali X-rays khaas angles par diffract hoti hain aur screen par diffraction patterns banati hain. Mathematical models se analyse karke atomic positions, bond angles aur electron density ka naqsha milta hai (jaise naphthalene, Figure 31.5).

Istemal:
• DNA ki double helix structure maloom karna (sab se mashhoor istemal)
• Enzymes aur proteins jaise pecheeda biomolecules ka tajziya
• Dawa banana – dawa ka molecule target se kaise judta hai
• Minerals, synthetic crystals aur nanomaterials ka tajziya taake electronics, optics aur construction mein performance behtar ho

book_ref.quote: It is important in material science, biochemistry, and pharmaceutical chemistry

blocks.prompt:
17 What are fossil fuels? Describe petroleum, natural gas and coal with their main products and uses, and state the environmental effect of burning them. (4 marks)
(Fossil fuels kya hain? Petroleum, natural gas aur coal un ki bari products aur istemal ke saath bayan karein, aur unhen jalane ka mahol par asar batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Petroleum (crude oil), coal aur natural gas mil kar fossil fuels kehlate hain.

Petroleum: zameen ke neeche ke zakhair se nikal kar bare plants mein fractional distillation se refine hota hai. Bari products: naphtha, gasoline, kerosene, diesel. Istemal: transport fuels (petrol, diesel) aur lubricants.

Natural gas: zyada tar methane (CH₄), saath ethane, propane, butane. Methane se ammonia (khaad) aur methanol (solvents aur fuel) bante hain. Istemal: khana pakana, garmi, bijli, khaad.

Coal: pehle jitna mufeed nahi magar jahan zakhair zyada hain wahan petrochemical raw material; is se benzene, toluene, xylene milte hain jo dyes, resins aur explosives mein lagte hain. Istemal: bijli, cement aur steel industries.

Mahol par asar: fossil fuels jalane se CO₂ jaisi greenhouse gases banti hain jo air pollution, global warming aur climate change ka sabab hain.

book_ref.quote: Crude oil is mined at the underground reservoirs and refined in large size plants

blocks.prompt:
18 Describe the fractional distillation of crude oil. Name its fractions with their temperature ranges and uses. (4 marks)
(Crude oil ki fractional distillation bayan karein. Is ke fractions temperature range aur istemal ke saath batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Crude oil hydrocarbons ka pecheeda mixture hai. Fractional distillation ise hydrocarbons ke boiling points ke farq ki bunyaad par physical tareeqe se alag karti hai.

Tareeqa: crude oil ko furnace mein garam karke vapour banaya jata hai. Vapour fractionating column mein jata hai, aik ooncha tower jis mein ooper jate hue temperature aahista kam hota hai. Vapour ooper uthte hue apne boiling point ke mutabiq mukhtalif oonchaiyon par condense hota hai: bhari, zyada boiling point wale hydrocarbons neeche, halke ooper. Fractions mukhtalif satah se nikale jate hain.

Yeh process ahem hai kyun ke is se sanat, ghar aur transport ke liye petrochemicals milte hain.

book_ref.quote: During this process, the crude oil is heated inside a furnace until it is vaporized.

blocks.prompt:
19 What are petrochemicals and their derivatives? Give six petrochemicals with their derived products and uses. (4 marks)
(Petrochemicals aur un ke derivatives kya hain? Chhe petrochemicals un ki products aur istemal ke saath batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Petrochemicals woh chemicals hain jo zyada tar crude oil aur natural gas se refining aur transformation ke zariye milte hain. In se packaging, construction, textile, electronics aur medical shobon ki rozmarra cheezen banti hain.

Petrochemicals ke derivatives woh synthetic chemicals hain jo petrochemicals se polymerization, oxidation ya substitution jaisi tabdeeliyon se bante hain; yeh bohat ahem sanati products hain.

book_ref.quote: They are used to make diverse daily items found in several industries

blocks.prompt:
20 What is cracking and why is it necessary? Describe thermal cracking and catalytic cracking with examples. (4 marks)
(Cracking kya hai aur kyun zaroori hai? Thermal aur catalytic cracking misaalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Cracking woh chemical process hai jis mein bare hydrocarbon molecules (aam taur par naphtha ya heavy oils) garmi se toot kar chhote, mufeed molecules jaise alkenes bante hain. Yeh zaroori hai kyun ke chhote ethene aur propene plastics aur artificial rubber ke bare raw materials hain.

(i) Thermal cracking: bohat zyada temperature (aam taur par 450 °C - 750 °C) aur zyada pressure C–C bonds torte hain. Catalyst nahi hota, is liye zyada energy chahiye. Alkenes zyada bante hain jo plastic industry ke liye ahem hain. Misaal – decane se octane aur ethene:
C₁₀H₂₂ → C₈H₁₈ + C₂H₄

(ii) Catalytic cracking: zyada efficient aur jadeed refineries mein aam. Catalyst, aam taur par zeolites (aluminosilicates) ya silica-alumina, activation energy kafi kam karta hai, is liye reaction kam temperature (taqreeban 500 °C) aur pressure par hota hai, energy bachti hai aur products par behtar control hota hai. Misaal – heavy naphtha se chhoti chain alkenes:
Naphtha (heavy hydrocarbons) →(catalyst) C₂H₄ (ethene) + C₃H₆ (propene)

book_ref.quote: There are two primary methods used to achieve this: Thermal Cracking and Catalytic Cracking.

blocks.prompt:
21 What is reforming? State its purpose and explain its three reactions with equations. (4 marks)
(Reforming kya hai? Is ka maqsad batayein aur is ke teen reactions equations ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Reforming refining ka woh process hai jo hydrocarbons ki molecular structure ko nayi tarteeb deta hai. Cracking (jis mein molecules toot'te hain) ke bar-aks yeh seedhi chain alkanes ko branched ya cyclic (aromatic) structures mein badalta hai.

Maqsad: kam octane wali seedhi chains ko zyada octane wale branched ya aromatic fuels mein badal kar fuel ki quality behtar karna aur engine knocking rokna.

1. Isomerisation (branched hydrocarbons): seedhi chains zyada octane wale branched isomers banti hain.
C₆H₁₄ → iso-C₆H₁₄ (n-hexane se iso-hexane)

2. Cyclization (cyclic hydrocarbons): seedhi chains cyclic compounds banti hain.
C₆H₁₄ → C₆H₁₂ + H₂ (hexane se cyclohexane)

3. Aromatisation (dehydrocyclisation; kitab mein dehydrocoupling): hydrogen nikal kar aromatic hydrocarbons jaise BTX (benzene, toluene, xylene) bante hain jo plastics, dyes aur synthetic fibres ke building blocks hain. Hexane mustahkam aromatic ring banata hai aur hydrogen qeemti by-product ke taur par nikalti hai.
C₆H₁₄ →(Pt catalyst/heat) C₆H₆ + 4H₂ (hexane se benzene)

book_ref.quote: Reforming is a refining process that rearranges the molecular structure of hydrocarbons.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book correction: kitab is equation ko '(cyclohexane to benzene)' likhti hai, magar C₆H₁₄ → C₆H₆ + 4H₂ hexane ke liye balanced hai. Cyclohexane se C₆H₁₂ → C₆H₆ + 3H₂ hota. Is step ka aam naam dehydrocyclisation (aromatisation) hai.

blocks.prompt:
22 Answer both parts. (i) 568 g of decane is thermally cracked: C₁₀H₂₂ → C₈H₁₈ + C₂H₄. Calculate the masses of octane and ethene formed. (ii) 172 g of hexane is converted into benzene: C₆H₁₄ → C₆H₆ + 4H₂. Calculate the masses of benzene and hydrogen formed. (Molar masses: C₁₀H₂₂ = 142, C₈H₁₈ = 114, C₂H₄ = 28, C₆H₁₄ = 86, C₆H₆ = 78, H₂ = 2 g mol⁻¹.) (4 marks)
(Dono hisse hal karein. (i) 568 g decane ki thermal cracking hoti hai: C₁₀H₂₂ → C₈H₁₈ + C₂H₄. Octane aur ethene ka mass maloom karein. (ii) 172 g hexane benzene mein badalta hai: C₆H₁₄ → C₆H₆ + 4H₂. Benzene aur hydrogen ka mass maloom karein. (Molar masses: C₁₀H₂₂ = 142, C₈H₁₈ = 114, C₂H₄ = 28, C₆H₁₄ = 86, C₆H₆ = 78, H₂ = 2 g mol⁻¹.))
blocks.explanation: Reactant ke mass ko moles mein badlein, har equation ka mole ratio lagayein aur jaanchein ke kul mass barabar rahe.

book_ref.quote: can be thermally cracked to produce octane and ethene

blocks.final_answer: (i) Octane 456 g, ethene 112 g; (ii) benzene 156 g, hydrogen 16 g.

blocks.prompt:
23 Define energy density and specific energy. Explain where each is important, with examples of diesel, gasoline, hydrogen and CNG. (4 marks)
(Energy density aur specific energy ki definition likhein. Diesel, gasoline, hydrogen aur CNG ki misaalon ke saath batayein ke har aik kahan ahem hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Fuel ko kisi kaam ke liye parakhne ke do ahem pehlu hain.

Energy density: substance ki energy capacity, yani fuel ke fi unit volume mein store energy, aam taur par MJ/L. Zyada energy density wale fuels kam volume mein zyada energy rakhte hain aur stationary kaamon aur storage, jaise power plants aur generators, mein mufeed hain. Diesel (~35.8 MJ/L) gasoline (~34.2 MJ/L) se zyada energy dense hai, yani fi litre zyada energy.

Specific energy: mass mein mojood energy, aam taur par MJ/kg. Yeh wahan ahem hai jahan wazan ahem ho, jaise aviation ya spacecraft; zyada specific energy wala fuel zyada mass barhaye baghair bohat energy deta hai. Hydrogen ki specific energy bohat zyada (120 MJ/kg) hai, is liye aerospace ke liye dilchasp hai, agarche energy density kam hai.

CNG: Pakistan mein transport ke liye sasti, magar kam energy density ki wajah se petrol ke muqable mein zyada storage volume chahiye; is liye local safar ke liye theek, lambe safar ke liye nahi.

blocks.prompt:
25 What is nuclear energy? Explain nuclear fission with an equation and the chain reaction, and discuss its use and drawbacks in power generation. (4 marks)
(Nuclear energy kya hai? Nuclear fission equation aur chain reaction ke saath samjhayein, aur bijli banane mein is ka istemal aur khamiyan bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Nuclear energy atom ke nuclei se nikalne wali energy hai, jab bhari nuclei toot'te hain (fission) ya halke nuclei judte hain (fusion). Yeh reactions chemical reactions ke muqable mein bohat zyada energy dete hain.

Fission: bhara nucleus jaise uranium-235 ya plutonium-239 do halke nuclei mein toot'ta hai aur energy, neutrons aur radiations nikalti hain.
²³⁵U + ¹₀n → ¹⁴¹Ba + ⁹²Kr + 3¹₀n + energy

Chain reaction: bane hue neutrons doosre nuclei ki mazeed fission karte hain, is tarah reaction khud chalta rehta hai.

Istemal: nuclear power plants bijli ke liye fission bohat istemal karte hain; thore fuel se bohat energy milti hai.

Khamiyan: radioactive waste banta hai jise lambe arse ehtiyat se sambhalna parta hai, aur nuclear hadsaat ka khatra hai, jaise Chernobyl (1986) aur Fukushima (2011), jin se mahol aur insaani sehat ko sakht nuqsan hua (Fukushima mein 150,000 se zyada log nikale gaye).

blocks.prompt:
26 Describe the working of a solar photovoltaic (PV) system and state the advantages of solar energy. (4 marks)
(Solar photovoltaic (PV) system ka kaam bayan karein aur solar energy ke faide batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Solar PV system aik saaf (clean) energy system hai.

Kaam (Figure 31.7):
• Solar panels, aam taur par silicon semiconducting materials ke, photovoltaic effect se roshni ko bijli banate hain: roshni material ke electrons ko activate karti hai aur DC bijli banti hai.
• Inverter DC ko AC mein badalta hai taake ghar, schools, offices aur industries chal saken.
• Batteries raat ya baadal wale din ke liye bijli store karti hain aur voltage stable aur surge current mein madad deti hain.
• Electrical accessories, wires, appliances aur mounting structures poore system ko mufeed aur mehfooz banate hain.

Faide:
• Mahol dost aur renewable, is liye climate change aur pollution se larne mein madad.
• Lambe arse mein sasta, kyun ke lagne ke baad kam dekh-bhaal chahiye.
Energy ki kami, mehnga fuel aur climate masail batate hain ke solar, hydro aur wind jaise renewable sources ki taraf jana zaroori hai.
